finding: The production corrective retrieval intentionally tightens max_steps to min(current max_steps, steps_used + 4). Requiring final_max_steps to equal 15 incorrectly rejects a smaller bound.
independent_review: A separate code reviewer verified actual charged steps, non-charged pick calls, token totals and production budget tightening before resumption.
decision: Resume the unchanged frozen runner only for unstarted trial IDs. Keep every completed trial, original failed gate, output and judgment unchanged. No model retry or quality-based replacement.
audit_invariant: Initial max_steps = 15 and wall clock = 180; final max_steps <= initial max_steps; reviewed actual steps <= final bound; any smaller final bound must follow exactly one permitted correction with final max_steps = min(15, charged steps at correction + 4). Other runtime gates remain mandatory.
reporting: List original gate failures separately from true budget violations; report the measured costs and unchanged quality outcomes.
